name: ae_definitions
text:
Schedule 1 - Definitions
These definitions apply only to this instrument.
Term Definition

"Notice" or "Notification" means a written communication.
The phrase term definition is part of this explanation.

"Record" has the meaning ascribed to the term "Register" in this instrument.
